limitations: CLE uses every visible-GT frame with output, including incorrect outputs; missing outputs excluded and reported separately.
TSR denominator is all visible-GT frames; missing output is failure and IoU=0.
Runs are observed consecutive visible-GT frames only, broken at unknown/unannotated/segment boundaries; not true occlusion recovery time.
Without annotated shot boundaries, runs may span scene edits. Sparse labels cannot establish full continuous lost duration.
Unknown-position outputs cannot be judged as FP, unlike outputs on confirmed-absent frames.
Failure images show low IoU; semantic wrong-object identity requires visual review.

detection.scope: Scheduled YOLO frames only; visible/confirmed-absent GT only. Unknown positions excluded.
detection.ap_definition: 101-point interpolated precision envelope, one ball class, IoU 0.5; candidates above configured floor after NMS.

performance.timing_scope: Fresh inference + decode + frontend + smoother + drawing + log/video writes and EOF tail; excludes setup/warmup/post-run evaluation; processing FPS excludes explicit pacing waits
performance.latency_scope: Unpaced file benchmark: wall times are NOT live latency
